name: Unilever PLC

listing.exchange: London Stock Exchange (also Euronext Amsterdam; NYSE ADR)

corporate_actions.event: Ice cream demerged as The Magnum Ice Cream Company (separately listed); prior-year figures restated for continuing operations; Unilever retained a minority stake (size not re-verified)

Agreement to combine Unilever Foods (Knorr, Hellmann's; ex India/Nepal/Portugal) with McCormick: Unilever + shareholders to own 65% of combined company plus USD15.7bn cash; close expected by mid-2027 subject to shareholder/regulatory approval

geography.fx_notes: EUR reporter; currency -5.9% on 2025 turnover. Emerging markets 58% / developed 42%; US ~20%, India ~11% (PitchBook/Morningstar description, S4). UK % not retrieved (UK-listed but UK consumer exposure is small single-digit %, not verified).

kpis.name: Portfolio mix by value
kpis.value: Beauty, wellbeing & personal care 51%, Home care 23%, Foods 26%

company_fcf.definition: Unilever FCF (net cash from operating activities - net capex; after lease payments per company definition)

lease.notes: not retrieved this session; methodology lease proxy applies

acquisitions.notes: Ten portfolio transactions completed/announced since start-2025 (e.g. Wild, Dr.Squatch per press); amounts not retrieved

management.senior_turnover_5y: High: CEOs Jope (to 2023) -> Schumacher (Jul-2023 to Feb-2025) -> Fernandez; CFO changed 2025
management.succession_notes: Board replaced Schumacher after ~18 months citing pace of change; internal successor (former CFO)
management.guidance_record: 2024-2025 USG within/near 3-5% guidance; FY2026 USG 4-6% guided, UVG upgraded to >=3% at Q3

activists.name: Trian Fund Management (Nelson Peltz)
activists.company_response: Peltz joined board 2022; current status not re-verified this session

B.rationale: Strong brands with demonstrated pricing power; mid-tier brands weaker.

C.rationale: Scale present but margin below best-in-class HPC peers.

D.rationale: Moderate runway via EM penetration and premium beauty.

E.rationale: Global spread but heavy EM/FX exposure.

evidence: Foods sale for 65% stock + USD15.7bn cash (S3)
G.rationale: Active portfolio reshaping; returns of disposals/acquisitions unproven.

I3.rationale: Some productivity scope in marketing content and supply chain.

evidence: Price stepped up Q3-26 to offset commodity costs (S2)
J.rationale: Partial, lagged pass-through; commodity-sensitive Home Care.

evidence: Diluted EPS EUR2.59 vs underlying EUR3.08 (S1)
K.rationale: Material recurring restructuring/non-underlying items; cash conversion ~100%.

ai.notes: No AI/data-centre or semis revenue (business mix, S4).

sector_specific.private_label_risk: Medium in Home Care/Foods in Europe; low-medium in premium beauty/personal care (INFERENCE)
sector_specific.comparability: 2025 restated for ice cream demerger; Foods (~26%) to leave by mid-2027 -> pre-2025 series not like-for-like
sector_specific.china_note: China a small share; not quantified this session

gates.notes: G6 B: material pending transaction (Foods ~26% of sales to McCormick, close mid-2027) changes earnings base and comparability; not an agreed takeover of Unilever. G7: UK-domiciled but UK consumer revenue small (not quantified) - C. G4: FCF EUR5.9bn ~100% cash conversion (S1).

bull_points: Volume-led recovery: 9M-26 UVG 3.8%, upgraded FY26 UVG >=3% (S2)
Portfolio pivot to higher-growth HPC/beauty after ice cream and foods exits; USD15.7bn cash proceeds (S3)
Strong EM franchises (India, LatAm, SE Asia)
bear_points: EM 58% of sales brings FX volatility (-5.9% in 2025) and macro risk (S1,S4)
Execution/dis-synergy risk across two large separations and three CEOs since 2023
thesis_breakers: FY2027 UVG below 1.5% for remaining HPC business
Foods transaction collapses or proceeds diverted to large low-return M&A
